_comment: Single source of truth for the payload ref. build-shell.mjs bakes this into DATA.github.ref / DATA.base, and verify-pipeline.mjs proves THAT SAME ref over the network — so the built plugin and the verifier can never disagree about which remote is live. Pin to an immutable tag, not a branch: a branch would let payloads change underneath installed caches. Override at build time with: node src/build-shell.mjs --ref main
